title: Bows and ranged presentation: upright bow, first-person draw pose with a nocked arrow, gun aim and recoil
player_outcome: Bows are held upright and show an arrow on the string that flies off as you click, then gets re-nocked. First-person guns point at the crosshair with a recoil kick instead of at the sky. Staffs tip toward the target.
design: PlayerAvatar.UpdateHeld: add a small HeldPose(ItemDef, ItemUseInfo) keyed by ActionFor. Bow: upright, grip in the fist, belly (model -X) toward the aim. Shoot, cast and other styles keep the current (90,0,0)/(0,0.08,0). Tune against the animation.cmds f_bow shot.
New partial game/Player/ViewModel.Ranged.cs; ViewModel._Process dispatches ranged styles to it by PlayerAvatar.ActionFor.

'bow' pose: bow vertical at view centre-right, belly to -Z. A nocked-arrow MeshInstance3D uses the PropLibrary model of the first arrow from ItemUseSystem.FindAmmo, refreshed at most 4 times a second and preloaded when the bow is selected, never at shot time. The arrow is hidden from Timing.bow.release until redrawStart, slides back onto the string by redrawEnd, and the bow kicks 3 cm forward at release.
'shoot' pose: barrel (+Y) along -Z toward the screen centre, recoil 6° up plus 4 cm back, decaying exponentially over 0.12 s from each UseSerial change or each Shot within a burst.
'cast' pose: staff tilted with its tip toward the crosshair and a small forward push on use.

animation.cmds: add first-person captures: 'camera first' / 'wield wooden_bow' / 'give wooden_arrow 20' / 'screenshot q_fp_bow_rest' / 'press use_primary' / 'wait 0.05' / 'screenshot q_fp_bow_release 0' / 'release use_primary' / 'wield flintlock_pistol' / 'screenshot r_fp_gun' / 'camera third'.
